info.name: AWS Serverless Trello Board Sync
info.description: API collection for testing the Trello Board Synchronization AWS Lambda endpoints locally or in the cloud.

request.description: Trello issues a HEAD request when a webhook is first created. Must return 200 OK.
Simulates a user creating a new card on the source board.
Simulates a user updating card title, description, or due date.
Tests loop prevention: should be enqueued and skipped cleanly by the worker because creator ID matches bot ID.
